scope: Rejected first Shadow-style Wuji background reconstruction
summary: v5 successfully introduced the thin stable forearm and wrist-overlap gate but was rejected by high-resolution review because its foreground-inclusive temporal median and broad row fill left rectangular clean-plate boundaries on the gray wall.
evidence: v5 forearm half-widths were fixed at 23.689233 and 27.637439 pixels with zero width step, and the wrist overlap minimum was 64 pixels.

v5 decoded to all 621 frames and reached 5.395365 effective FPS, but its static clean plate SHA-256 0c53bdb14dd2405e13fd445714a68e7c195c0210673820da661c50bb89530408 visibly contained a broad blockwise reconstruction.
Dense one-second review exposed the rectangular boundary behind and beside the thin forearm, so numerical outside-mask exactness did not override the human veto.
lessons: Temporal aggregation must exclude source-actor masks; otherwise a median can retain the actor and force an unnecessarily broad spatial fill.
Outside-mask exactness does not certify the visual quality of pixels inside the declared edit region.
limitations: This rejected artifact is retained only as failure evidence and must not be published as the demo result.
next_actions: Use a mask-excluded temporal mosaic and rerun the same frozen forearm and wrist gates.
